text:
andrew: starting config-only rollout now. Changes: batch_window_ms 25->10, per_tenant_qps 30->18, route_policy=latency-first (prefer warmer cache hosts). Canary 2% for 20m. deploy-bot queued.
deploy-bot: Canary cfg-canary-1728009999 initiated. weight=2%, batch_window_ms=10, per_tenant_qps=18, pinned_model=v2.2.0. health_checks=on.
lena: acked. I'll monitor p50/p95, kvcache hit rate, and tenancy split.
oncall-bot: baseline alerting set: p95>350ms for 5m triggers warning, p95>450ms for 3m triggers rollback recommendation.
andrew: agreed. document the rollback play: reduce weight -> 0, or fallback tenants -> v2.1.6 if tails persist.
(7m later)
sam: quick note 1: canary p95 climbed to ~480ms on 2 nodes. kvcache miss rate spiked ~18% on those hosts.
lena: curious 1: small batches may be increasing kvcache churn. can we revert batch_window back to 20ms for canary nodes only?
andrew: hold full ramp. Change plan: cut canary weight to 0.5%, change batch_window_ms -> 20 for canary, keep per_tenant_qps at 18, keep model pinned. executing via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: update in progress: weight -> 0.5% ... done; batch_window_ms -> 20 ... done.
oncall-bot: note: alert suppressed for previous spike, monitoring resumed.
sam: performed a selective fallback for affected tenants to v2.1.6 using selector "kvcache_miss_rate>15%". Command: ```/deploy fallback --canary cfg-canary-1728009999 --from v2.2.0 --to v2.1.6 --selector "kvcache_miss_rate>15%" --dry-run``` then executed without --dry-run after validation.
lena: thanks. please add tenant ids to TKT-24011.
andrew: created TKT-24011: "canary kvcache churn when batch_window small; follow-up: cache warming & eviction tuning". assigned to eng-runtime.
(12m later)
sam: canary p95 back to ~230ms. fallback affected ~0.9% traffic. kvcache miss rate stabilized.
lena: ran quick eval on model outputs for canary traffic: no semantic regressions.
andrew: plan: hold at 0.5% for 20m, then step to 3% if stable (step schedule: 0.5% -> 3% -> 10% over 90m). if p95>300ms at any step, pause and revert weight.
oncall-bot: temporary alert rule added: check p95 and kvcache_miss every 3m for canary nodes.
sam: adding to release notes draft: "config-only: tightened per-tenant QPS and adjusted batching; latency-first routing; surgical fallback applied for tenants with high kvcache miss rate; follow-up TKT-24011."
andrew: include change window: tonight 22:00-00:00 UTC for wider ramp. ops notified.
lena: small request: mark pinned_model=v2.2.0 in rollout metadata so we don't auto-upgrade model variant.
deploy-bot: pinned_model recorded = v2.2.0 in canary metadata.
(40m later)
sam: staged ramp to 3% now. p95 stable ~240ms. no new fallbacks.
andrew: ramp to 10% scheduled per plan, will post here when started. thanks for quick ops response. :party_parrot:
lena: leaving follow-up actions in TKT-24011: cache eviction policy audit, consider batching heuristics by tenant, and a-load test with smaller batch windows.
andrew: closing thread after 10% hold for 30m. marking this as successful config deploy unless anyone objects.
sam: no objections. documenting blameless summary in release notes channel. :white_check_mark:
